title: Level up your sustainable engineering practices with Google Cloud
description: Decarbonize your engineering practices with Google Cloud tools and AI-enabled capabilities. Join this session to learn how Google Cloud can help optimize your cloud architecture for the planet. We ll discuss new features of Carbon Footprint and integration with our latest AI tools including Gemini. Moreover, L'Oreal - the world s \#1 cosmetic company - will share its inspiring global sustainability program from factories to IT, as well as its practical strategies to greenify engineering practices with the help from Google Cloud s tools.
